prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 中文 · 电商订单 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "订单号" · longest unbreakable word 142px · one-line width 142px
  col 2: header "下单时间" · longest unbreakable word 37px · one-line width 77px
  col 3: header "商品" · longest unbreakable word 47px · one-line width 354px
  col 4: header "金额" · longest unbreakable word 61px · one-line width 61px
  col 5: header "收货地址" · longest unbreakable word 33px · one-line width 347px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 659px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 658px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示电商订单，便于查看订单明细、金额和收货信息。","reading":"读者按行核对单笔订单，也会纵向扫描订单号、下单时间和金额；商品与地址较长，可利用同一行的高度换行。","groups":["订单号和下单时间共同标识订单及其发生时间。","商品和金额共同描述购买内容及交易金额。","收货地址是履约信息，与同一行的订单和商品关联。"],"keep_intact":["订单号应完整显示，避免拆分连续数字。","金额应保持在一行，方便比较。","日期、时间及商品型号等不可自然拆分的片段应各自保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["商品名称可在自然断点换行。","收货地址可按地址层级或自然断点换行。","下单日期和时间可分成两行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [163, 98, 150, 82, 165] · table 659×214px · row heights [33, 73, 33, 73] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [163, 70, 195, 82, 148] · table 659×254px · row heights [53, 73, 53, 73] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [163, 98, 105, 82, 210] · table 659×234px · row heights [33, 53, 33, 114] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"订单号、时间和金额均完整单行显示，表头清晰；商品与地址共享较长行的高度，整体紧凑，便于逐行核对。","problems":"两条长地址分成三行，末行较短；第三条商品也分成三行，内容略显拥挤。","cause":"商品列150px、地址列165px，长内容的可用文本宽度分别只有129px和144px。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"较宽的商品列让长商品名称更舒展，订单号和金额仍完整显示。","problems":"下单时间表头断成两行，每条时间也都分行，使短订单行和表头都变高；地址仍有三行，商品列的增宽没有改善整表的行高。","cause":"时间列压缩到70px，无法容纳完整表头或单行时间；地址列缩至148px，长地址仍需多行。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"宽地址列使长地址缩至两行，订单号、时间和金额清晰完整。","problems":"商品列过窄，连第一条商品的数量也落到第二行；第三条商品被挤成五行，行高明显失衡，削弱了地址列增宽的收益。","cause":"商品列只有105px，可用文本宽度为84px；地址列210px占用了过多可供商品使用的宽度。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-refine","widths":[163,98,160,82,155],"change":"以r0A为基础，将10px从地址移给商品，检查能否改善长商品的断行，同时保持时间和表头完整。"},{"name":"address-lean","widths":[163,98,140,82,175],"change":"在r0A基础上适度加宽地址列，并保留比r0C更宽的商品列，探索地址和商品之间更均衡的换行。"},{"name":"compact-date","widths":[163,78,170,82,165],"change":"让日期和时间分行，但保留足够宽度容纳下单时间表头；把节省的宽度给商品，观察表头完整与长内容舒展之间的取舍。"}]}
